newScenarios.ccr-setpoint-bailout-30m: CCR, setpoint 1.2 bar, Tx 15/45 diluent, air setup cylinder. 10 min at 30 m in 6 s ticks; ] in a zero-length tick; 5 min at 30 m in 1 s ticks; B in a zero-length tick; ascent to 21 m at 9 m/min. Checkpoints: bottom-10min, setpoint-raised, bottom-15min, bailed-out, bailout-ascent-21m.
newScenarios.tec-switch-21m: Trimix 21/35 plus a 50% cylinder. 15 min at 30 m; ascent to 21 m; key 2 in a zero-length tick; 3 min at 21 m. Checkpoints: bottom-15min, ascent-21m, switched, deco-gas-3min.
newScenarios.whyZeroLengthTicks: Legacy's updateDiving() reads the keys after integrating the tissues and billing the gas, so a key read inside an ordinary tick splits that tick. For a switch, the tick integrates the old gas and bills the new one. The migration client acts between whole-second steps, where that split does not exist. A zero-length tick puts the key on a tick boundary, where both clients mean the same thing.
newScenarios.whyOneSecondTicks: After ], the loop climbs to the new setpoint within a few seconds. A 6 s legacy tick integrates that climb differently from six 1 s model steps, so the segment is recorded at the model's fixed step.
newScenarios.whyTheDiluentDiffers: As before: the diluent differs from the setup cylinder so the fixture records which gas a bailout forecast breathes (#183).

acceptanceMapping.tankSwitch: tec-switch-21m: one DiveModel from ascent-21m. switchGas(1) at the zero-length tick gives activeTankIndex 1 and one gas-switch event to cylinder 2, with tissues and both cylinders unchanged. Three minutes follow on the model's own breathing and billing, with tissues within 1e-9 and both cylinders within 1e-6 L.
acceptanceMapping.setpointAndBailout: ccr-setpoint-bailout-30m: one DiveModel from bottom-10min, carried through every later checkpoint. adjustSetpoint(+0.1) gives setpoint 1.3 exactly and no event. In the five minutes after it, the model's own loop climbs to 1.3 and matches loop PO2 (1e-9), tissues (1e-9), O2 and diluent pressure (1e-6) and scrubber time (1e-6 min). bailOut() gives one bailout event, and a second call changes nothing. The ascent on the diluent matches tissues and diluent pressure.
acceptanceMapping.oneDiveNotPossible: No single legacy dive holds all three acts: a CCR dive has one open-circuit cylinder in legacy too (TASK-019 loops to tankCount).

notComparedAndWhy.nothingOverridden: Nothing is injected: no breathing source, no loop PO2. Every field a checkpoint records for these segments is compared.

counterCheck.method: One revert at a time in src/core/dive-model.ts, restoring from a copy taken beforehand, run against the replay file.

cases.loopIgnoresSetpoint: the loop injects toward a fixed 1.2 bar instead of the target — the CCR replay fails
cases.gasBilledToFirstCylinder: open-circuit billing always charges cylinder 1 — the switch replay fails, off by 139.5 L
cases.placeholderAfterBailout: breathingSourceForState() returns tanks[active] on bailout — the CCR replay fails

counterCheck.oneRevertDidNotApplyAtFirst: The billing revert first used a multi-line match that missed the CRLF source. The script said so, and the 'passed' it printed ran against unmodified code. It was rewritten as a single-line match and rerun, and then failed as expected.

switchBillingSkipped.finding: major contract-violation — the switch replay injected breathing, which skipped gas billing, and asserted no cylinder.
switchBillingSkipped.fix: Zero-length key tick in a new tec-switch-21m scenario; replay on the model's own billing; both cylinders asserted.

setpointEffectInjected.finding: major contract-violation — the five-minute replay supplied the loop PO2 itself and asserted the fixture's value, so a loop that ignored the setpoint would still pass.
setpointEffectInjected.fix: One continuing model with its own loop, over a segment recorded in 1 s ticks; loop PO2, O2, diluent and scrubber asserted.

supersedes.why: The injected-breathing replays that review round 1 rejected.
